text: Listen to your lawyer. Change plans - meet in the third country or visit her in Lithuania (these restrictions don't apply there). I understand that you're stressed now, but Israel is not the only place to meet (and complicate the entire process, which is not flowers and rainbows anyway) 😊 I'm also Lithuanian, by the way, so welcome to the club! 🙌🏼 And P.S. you may of course consult with a lawyer here and there, but you definitely don't need one to lead the process if you don't have any extraordinary circumstances. It's completely doable. Save money, meet in Cyprus three times instead 😄
